note: Private RV park on the east edge of Bismarck (5700 E Main Ave), about 3 mi from I-94 exit 161. Gravel full-hookup sites in angled rows and a loop among mature trees, an electric-only pull-through overflow row beside the RV storage lot, and a block of private mobile homes within the park. Playground and ball court. --Claude

LONG-STAY: passes, not mostly seasonal. The home page leads with 'daily or weekly rates' and electric-only 'pull through daily sites in our overflow area'; monthly (28-day) full-hookup stays are offered ('call for rates'; 'Management reserves the right to not allow Monthly Guests with RV's that are older than 20 years'), and the site map shows a 'Private Mobile Homes' block inside the park. Newest Google reviews are mostly short stays: 3 months ago 'probably would stay elsewhere next time we're rolling through' (put in the overflow area); 5 months ago 'will be here for only 3 nights'; a month ago a worker 'staying at there campground because I was working out of state'; 4 days ago 'they closed Thanksgiving ... they extended us till December 4th'. Nightly share not measurable (no engine), but daily sites are marketed and a self-registration kiosk takes walk-ins.
SEASON: no dates on the operator site ('We are open for the 2026 Season!'); stored derived 04-01..11-30 left. A review 4 days ago says the park closes at Thanksgiving.
